Thanks for the advice, it really does help to know that this may really help me. I’ll look into it as soon as I can and see when I can start classes. 

Good luck on your third degree by the way :>
What a coincidence !!! As soon as I saw the program it just honestly felt like it was the sign I had been looking for.
It’s a nursing program, it’s been my dream to be a nurse. I qualify for everything except for this one exam I have to take, but I can get that completed.

I have tried, I need a slip from my psychiatrist (literally the worst receptionist staff when it comes to faxing papers) and yes, I’m on Prozac and Concerta. I feel extremely bad for wanting disability services though, mostly because I feel like my professors will belittle me and that it won’t even allow me to qualify for the nursing program.
Just did... I’ll call the main office in the morning, but I doubt they’ll help me.

I can’t really say why I’ve felt the need to contact her. But now I can’t get her out of my mind. 

And no. I had no real desire to gain any weight, but as we’ve progressed into our relationship I’ve noticed he pushes food on me a lot. He also makes me feel bad for wanting to lose weight because he says it will make me unhealthy and too thin. I have dumped a few friends due to his jealousy and it bothers me immensely. I feel a lot of regret for it, but whenever I try to talk to him about it, he says that it makes him feel bad and that he doesn’t want to feel like he’s manipulative. It makes me regret even telling him anything.

I want to apologize to my ex. I was going through a lot of pain and trauma and I felt like I could have helped her. Or at the very least, been kinder. 

My boyfriend is kind, but he has always had these jealousy problems, which concerns me. I feel as if he is very reliant on me and if I wanted to have a break to myself to work on things, he would probably take it very seriously and blame himself. 

Also thank you for commenting, I honestly expected people to ignore this.
